text:
tanya: Quick follow-up from today's authz outage. Want a tight plan to close remediation this sprint and reduce repeats.
tanya: Root cause recap: rotation runner lost write perms after a bot role update; audit pipeline retried and dropped a small window of events. Two failures combined = silent token validation failures.
minh: I'll own a short-term guardian and an infra ticket for perms hardening. ETA: guardian + alert by 2026-04-04.
minh: alert sketch:
```
# prom alert: rotation_missed_count
expr: increase(rotation_missed_total[10m]) > 0
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```
pavel: I'll handle audit backfill tooling and a validation query. Targeting 2026-04-03 for draft. Will do dry-run in staging first.
security-eng: We'll write the runbook and propose SLOs for token-validation. Preliminary SLO: 99.95% over 7d, page if <99.9% for 30m. Draft by 2026-04-02.
ops-bot: Reminder: remediation sync Thu 09:00 PT. Auto-reminder 24h prior.
tanya: Please create tracker tasks and link PRs/issues here. When you close an item, post a one-line status here so we can mark the postmortem remediated.
minh: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1301 - guardian exporter + alert. PTAL.
pavel: Issue with backfill plan: https://redwood-internal/issue/9102 - includes ES query and staging run notes.
security-eng: Runbook stub: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/token_remediation.md - adding SLO rationale and escalation steps today.
tanya: Note on recurrence: we've seen rotation-related incidents multiple times this year. After immediate fixes, let's add a monthly smoke test that does rotation -> ingest verification and surface token-health on dashboard.
minh: I'll add the smoke test job and wire result to a token_health metric.
pavel: Backfill will be idempotent and use event_id dedupe; will post dry-run results in the issue before any prod run.
tanya: Thanks all. If any ETA slips, flag early. Post a one-line completion here when done so we can close the remediation loop. :white_check_mark:
